Good stuff, but some tweaks would be dope. Awesome setup/layout. Love using app & recording/exporting audio onto iOS Garageband for ideas.

Only noticeable chord layout I noticed missing is suspended 2nd chords (xsus2). I know you can play the same tones by changing desired root up to its 4th tone as a suspended 4th, but would be cool to not have to think it all out.

Also, I have yet to see an app do this but I think a capo option would make this a 6/5 stars. Like pick where you wanna place the capo and if you want to go by actual chord “tone” or “chord shape” with the capo. Ex. If you do capo 2 you can set it up that you can play Cmaj7 chord shape (which will actually play Dmaj7 tones) or call it Dmaj7 instead if you want.. If that makes sense.
